text.body:
<atha snānavidhiḥ | <atha sandhyopāsanā ||śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇama'stu ||> < for all three times of day p. 4 to p. 12>
<atha śivastutiḥ || iti abhinavaguptā'cāryakṛtā śivastutiḥ p. 42 >
{nityakarmavidhiḥ}
atha [snānavidhiḥ] |
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajādhṛtivasūni ca | brahmaprajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvaṃ no dehi vanaspate || iti dantadhāvanamaṃtraḥ
namo'stva'nantāya sahasramūrtaye sahasrapādā'kṣiśirorubāhave | sahasranāmne puruṣāya śāśvate sahasrakoṭīyugadhāriṇe namaḥ || iti vāmapādaprakṣā(0)
namaḥ kamalanābhāya namaste jalaśāyine | namaste keśavā'nanta vāsudeva namo'stu te || iti dakṣiṇapādaprakṣālanam
gaṃgāprayāgagayanaimiṣapuṣkarāditīrthāni yāni bhuvi santi hariprasādāt | āyāntu tāni karapadmapuṭe madīye prakṣālayantu vadanasya niśākalaṅkam ||
tīrthe sneyaṃ tīrthameva samānānāṃ bhavati mānaḥ | śaṃsyo araruṣo dhūrtiḥ prāṇaṅ martyasya rakṣāṇo brahmaṇaspate || iti mukhaprakṣālanam
oṃ gāyatryai namaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvastatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt (3) || iti yajñasūtrapra(0) | gāyatryaiva śikahamābaddhya
yajñopavītaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ prajāpateryatsahajaṃ purastāt | āyuṣyamagryaṃ pratimuñca śubhraṃ yajñopavītaṃ balamastu tejaḥ || yajñopavītama'si yajñasya tvā upavītena upanahyāmi | iti yajñasūtradhāraṇam
kṛtvā'laṃ pādaśaucaṃ vimalama'tha jalaṃ triḥ pibedunmṛjeddvi(-) starjanya'ṅguṣṭhakābhyāṃ sajalama'bhimṛśennāsikārandhrayugmam | aṅguṣṭhā'nāmikābhyāṃ nayanayugalakaṃ karṇayugmaṃ kaniṣṭhā(-) 'ṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ nābhideśaṃ hṛdayama'tha talenā'ṅgulībhiḥ śiroṃsau ||
tataḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ | oṃ brahmaṇo'gnyādayaḥ | namo agnaye apsuṣade nama indrāya namo varuṇāya namo vāruṇyai namo'pāṃpataye namo'dbhyaḥ || iti namaskāraḥ
avabhṛthe triṣṭup varuṇaḥ ||
uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaścakāra sūryāya panthāma'nveta vā u | apade pādā pratidhātave'ka rutā'pavaktā hṛdayāvidhaścit || iti upasthānam
yamasya rājño jagatī varuṇaḥ ||
ye te śataṃ varuṇa ye sahasraṃ yajñiyāḥ pāśā vitatā mahāntaḥ | tebhirno devaḥ savitā bṛhaspatirviśve devā maruto muṃcantu svarkāḥ || iti jalaṃ trirāvartayet
nicāṅkuṇasya śunaḥ śepasya cā'paḥ sumitriyāna āpaḥ oṣadhayo bhavantu | durmitriyāstasmai santu yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ || iti vāmabhāge jalāñjalitrayaṃ kṣipet ||
yatkiñcedaṃ varuṇa deve jane'bhidrohaṃ manuṣyāścarāmasi | acitte yattava dharmāya yo'pi samānastasmādenaso deva rīriṣaḥ || iti namasyet
tato mṛdo bhāgatrayaṃ kṛtkā prathamabhāge jalasecanam | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ (3) ||
dvitīyabhāge jalasecanam || tritasya mahāpaṃktirāḍityāḥ | ādityā ava hi khyātā dikkūlāddivaspṛśaḥ sutīrthāḥ sarvato yathā | nunnoneṣayā sugama'nehaso va ūtayaḥ su ūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
tṛtīyabhāge jalasecanam | medhātithergāyatraṃ viṣṇuḥ ||
ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇurvicakrame pṛthivyāḥ sapta dhāmabhiḥ | tatastṛtīyāṃśasya bhāgacatuṣkaṃ vidhāya caturdikṣu kṣipet ||
bhargasya bṛhatī indraḥ yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃkṛdhi |
maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtabhirvidviṣo vimṛdho jahi | iti pūrve ||
śāsasyā'nuṣṭubhau vimṛdha indraḥ | svastidāviśaspatirvṛtrahā vimṛdhovaśī |
vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ somapā abhayaṃkaraḥ || iti dakṣiṇe
virakṣo vimṛdho jahi vivṛtrasya hanūruja | vimanyumindra vṛtrahanna'mitrasyā bhidā sataḥ || iti paścime
vasukrasya triṣṭubindraḥ | idaṃ su me jaritaraḥ cikiddhi pratīpaṃ śāpaṃ | nadyo vahanti lopāśāḥ siṃhaṃ pratyaṃca matsyāḥ kroṣṭā varāhā nniratatthakakṣyāt || iti uttare
yajñasyā'nuṣṭup mṛttikā ||
aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasundhare | uddhṛtāsi varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā ||
mṛttike tvāṃ ca gṛhṇāmi prajayā ca dhanena ca | mṛttike brahmadattā'si kaśyapenā'bhimantritā ||
mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | vācā kṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ manasā yattu cintitam ||
mṛttike dehi me puṣṭiṃ tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | tvayā hṛtena pāpena brahmalokaṃ vrajāmya'ham ||
iti abhimaṃtritayā dvitīyamṛdā jalāloḍitayā nābherūrdhvaṃ viśodhayet ||
tataḥ prathamāṃśasya bhāgacatuṣkaṃ vidhāya kutsasya rudro jagatī ||
mānastoke tanaye māna āyau mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ | vīrānmā no rudra bhāmito vadhīrhaviṣmanto namasā vidhema te || iti lalāṭamādyāṃśa mṛdā'nulipya
oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ svaḥ iti vāmāṃse 'o mahaḥ oṃ janaḥ oṃ tapaḥ iti dakṣiṇāṃse oṃ satyamiti hṛdaye dvitīyāṃśenā'nulipya | tato namaskāraḥ ||
tīrthasyā'vāhanaṃ kuryāttatpravakṣyāmya'nantaram | kurukṣetraṃ gayā gaṃgā prabhāsaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca ||
tīrthānyetāni sarvāṇi snānakāle bhavantu me | prapadye varuṇaṃ devama'mbhasāṃ patimūrjitam ||
yācitaṃ dehi me tīrthaṃ sarvapāpā'panuttaye | rudrānprapadye varadānsarvāna'psuṣadastva'ham ||
sarvāna'psuṣadaścaiva prapadye praṇataḥ sthitaḥ | devama'psuṣadaṃ vahniṃ prapadye'ghaniṣūdanam ||
āpaḥ puṇyāḥ pavitrāśca prapadye śaraṇaṃ tathā | rudraścā'gniśca sarpāśca varuṇastvā'pa eva ca ||
śamayantvā'śu me pāpaṃ punantvete sadā mama | ityevamuktvā kartavyaṃ tataḥ saṃmārjanaṃ jale ||
atha jalāṃjaliṃ tṛtīyāṃśamṛtsahitaṃ gṛhītvā ||
apāṃpataye vidmahe pāśapāṇaye dhīmahi tanno varuṇaḥ pracodayāt (3) | oṃ tatsat brahma adya tāvattithāva'dya amukamāsasya amukapakṣasya tithāva'mukāyāṃ āgmano vāṅmanaḥkāyopārjitapāpanivāraṇārthaṃ śrīnārāyaṇaprītya'rthaṃ amukanadyāḥ pravāhe snānamahaṃ kariṣye oṃ kuruṣva || iti pravāhāntaḥ kṣiptvā || śirasi jalama'ñjalinā prakṣipet ||
oṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ divīva cakṣurā'tatam | tadviprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam ||
oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ svaḥ oṃ mahaḥ oṃ janaḥ oṃ tapaḥ oṃ satya miti mārjayecchiraḥ ||
oṃ haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasura'ntarikṣasa ddhotā vediṣada'tithirduroṇasat | nṛṣadvarasa dṛtasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtam || iti upasthānam
oṃ namo devabhyaḥ kaṇṭhopavītī svāhā ṛṣibhyaḥ | apasavyena svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ savyena ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaraṃ jagattṛpyatu tṛpyatu tṛpyatu evama'stu ||
yattvaga'sthigataṃ pāpaṃ janmāntarakṛtaṃ ca yat | tanme harasva kalyāṇi mūrdhni sparśena vaiṣṇavi || iti pariśiṣṭamṛdā tilakaṃ kāryam
atha vastradhāraṇam ||
yuvā suvāsāḥ parivīta āgātsa ucchreyānbhavati jāyamānaḥ | tandhīrāsaḥ kavaya unnayaṃti sādhyo manasā devayantaḥ ||
asmatkule tu ye jātā aputrā gotravarjitāḥ | te pibantu mayā dattaṃ vastraniṣpīḍanodakam || iti snānapaṭṭapīḍanam
[iti snānavidhiḥ] ||
[atha sandhyopāsanā] ||
śrīmahāgāyatryai namaḥ | sāvitryai namaḥ | sarasvatyai namaḥ ||
oṃ praṇavasya ṛṣirbrahmā gāyatraṃ chanda eva ca | devo'gnirvyāhṛtiṣu ca viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
prajāpatervyāhrṭayaḥ pūrvasya parameṣṭhinaḥ | vyastāścaiva samastāśca brāhmama'kṣaramomiti ||
vyāhṛtīnāṃ samastānāṃ daivataṃ tu prajāpatiḥ | vyastānāma'yama'gniśca vāyuḥ sūryaśca devatāḥ ||
chandaśca vyāhṛtīnāme kā'kṣarāṇāmuktākhyam dvyakṣarāṇāma'tyuktākhyam | viśvāmitra ṛṣiśchando gāyatraṃ savitā tathā ||
daivatopanaye japye gāyatryā yoga ucyate | āvāhayāmi gāyatrīṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm ||
na gāyatryā paraṃ japyaṃ na vyāhṛtisamaṃ hṛtam | āgaccha varade devi japye me sannidhau bhava ||
gāyantaṃ trāyase yasmādgāyatrī tvaṃ tataḥ smṛtā | evamā'rṣaṃ chando daivataṃ viniyogaṃ cā'nusmṛtya ||
gāyatryā śikahamā'baddhya gāyatryaiva samantataḥ | ātmanaścāpaḥ parikṣipya prāṇāyāmaṃ kuryāt || iti namaskṛtya
athā'ñjaliṃ kṛtvā ||
ojo'sīti gāyatrīmā'vāhya | devānāmā'rṣam ||
ojo'si saho'si balama'si bhrājo'si devānāṃdhāma nāmāsi | viśvama'si viśvāyuḥ sarvama'si sarvāyura'bhibhūḥ || atha prāṇāyāmamaṃtraḥ
oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ svaḥ oṃ mahaḥ oṃ janaḥ oṃ tapaḥ oṃ satyaṃ (-)
oṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yonaḥ pracodayāt (-)
oṃ āpo jyotīraso'mṛtaṃ brahma bhūrbhuvaḥ svarom || iti paṭhan pūrakakumbhakarecakeṣu nābhihṛdayalalāṭeṣu raktanīlaśvatān brahmaviṣṇuśivān dhyāyan prāṇāyāmaṃ kuryāt |
savyāhṛtiṃ sapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha | triḥ paṭhedā'yataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate ||
ekāvartaḥ pūrakaḥ syātkambhako dviguṇastathā | recakastriguṇaḥ proktaḥ praveśasthitirnirgamairiti ||
oṃ agniśca mā manyuśca manyupatayaśca manyukrtebhyaḥ pāpebhyo rakṣantām | yada'hnā pāpama'kārṣaṃ manasā vācā hastābhyāṃ padbhyāmudareṇa śiśnā | ahastada'valumpatu yatkiṃcidduritaṃ mayīdama'hamā'po'mṛtayonau satye jyotiṣi juhomi svāhā || iti sāyamā'camanatrayam
oṃ sūryaśca mā manyuśca manyupatayaśca manyukṛtebhyaḥ pāpebhyo rakṣantām | yadrātryā pāpamakārṣaṃ manasā vācā hastābhyāṃ padbhyāmudareṇa śiśnā | rātristada'valumpatu yatkiṃcidduritaṃ mayīdama'hamā'po'mṛtayonau | sūrye jyotiṣi juhomi svāhā || itiprātarā'camanatrayam
oṃ āpaḥ punantu pṛthivīṃ pṛthivī pūtā punātu mām | punātu brahmaṇaspatirbrahma pūtaṃ punātu mām ||
yaducchiṣṭama'bhojyaṃ vā yadva aduścaritaṃ mama | sarvaṃ punantu māmā'po'satāṃ ca pratigrahaṃ juhomi svāhā || iti madhyāhne trayam
oṃ āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo bhuva (-)stā na ūrje dadhāta na mahe raṇāya cakṣase || 1 ||
yo vaḥ śivatamo rasa(-)stasya bhājayate hanaḥ uśatīriva mātaraḥ || 2 ||
tasmā araṃgamāma vaḥ yasya kṣayāya jinvatha āpo janayathā ca naḥ || 3 ||
oṃ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ kaśyapo yāsvindraḥ | yā agniṃ garbhaṃ dadhire virūpā stā na āpaḥ śaṃsyonā bhavantu || 4 ||
oṃ yāsāṃ devā divi kṛṇvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ yā antarikṣe bahudhā bhavanti | yā(0) 5 ||
oṃ yāsāṃ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyā'nṛte avapaśyañjanānām | yā(0) 6 ||
oṃ śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyatā'paḥ śivayā tanvopaspṛśata tvacaṃ me | madhuścyutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakā stā na āpaḥ śaṃsyonā bhavantu || 7 ||
oṃ śanno devīra'bhīṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye śaṃyyora'bhisravantu naḥ || 8 ||
oṃ śanna āpo dhanvanyaḥ śannaḥ santva'nūpyāḥ | śannaḥ samudriyā na āpaḥ śamunaḥ santu kūpyāḥ || 9 ||
oṃ āpo asmānmātaraḥ śundhayantu ghṛtena mā ghṛtapvaḥ punantu | viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devī rudidā'bhyaḥ śucirā'pūta emi || 10 ||
oṃ idamā'paḥ pravahata yatkiṃcidduritaṃ mayi | yadvā'hama'bhidadroha yadvā śeṣa utā'nṛtam || 11 ||
oṃ muñcantu mā śapathyāda'tho vāruṇyāduta | atho yamasya paḍvīśātsarvasmāddeva kilbiṣāt || 12 ||
oṃyajjāgradyatsuptaḥ pāpama'bhijagāma | sarvasmānmā tasmāde'nasaḥ pramuñcatu || 13 ||
oṃ dadhi krābṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇora'śvasya vājinaḥ | surabhi no mukhā karatprā' āyūṃṣi tāriṣat || 14 || iti mārjanamaṃtrāḥ
oṃ drupadādivonmumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snātvī malādiva | pūtaṃ pavitreṇevā'jya mā'paḥ śundhantu mainasaḥ || iti vāme jalāṃjalitrayaṃ kṣipet
oṃ ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cābhīddhā ttapaso'dhya'jāyata | tato rātrira'jāyata tataḥ samudro arṇavaḥ ||
samudrāda'rṇavāda'dhi saṃvatsaro ajāyata | ahorātrāṇi vyadadhadviśvasya miṣaot vaśī ||
sūryācandramasau dhātā yathāpūrvama'kalpayat | divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cā'ntarikṣama'tho svaḥ || iti jalamadhyasthakaradvayo japet
oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ svaḥ oṃmahaḥ oṃjanaḥ oṃ tapaḥ oṃ satyamiti śiro mārjayet ||
oṃ antaścarasi bhūteṣu guhāyāṃ viśvato mukhaḥ |
tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāra āpo jyotīraso'mṛtaṃ brahma bhūrbhuvaḥ svaro mityā'camanatrayam || tataḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ tataḥ sūryā'bhimukho oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ || 3 || iti
gāyatryā'bhimaṃtritāṃstrīñjalalīnutkṣipya kṣipet | pradakṣiṇamā'vṛtyordhvabāhurudayantamiti sāyaṃprātarupatiṣṭheta ||
oṃ udvayantamasaspari jyotiṣpaśyanta uttaram | devaṃ devatrāḥ sūryama'ganma jyotiruttamam || 1 ||
oṃ udutyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ | dṛśe viśvāya sūryam || 2 ||
oṃ citrandevānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyā'gneḥ | ā prā dyāvāpṛthivī cāntarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca || 3 ||
oṃ taccakṣurdevahitaṃ purastācchukramuccarat | paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam || 4 ||
oṃ haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasura'ntarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat | nṛṣadvarasadṛtasadvyomasada'bjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtam || 5 ||
oṃ vibhrāḍbṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhadyajñapatā avihrutam | vāta jūtayo abhirakṣatyātmanā prajā piparti bahudhā virājati || 6 ||
iti madhyāhnopasthitiḥ | atha viṣṇuṃ dhyāyanpuruṣasūktaṃ paṭhet ||
oṃ ānuṣṭubhasya sūktasya triṣṭuba'ntasya devatā | viśvātmā puruṣaḥ sākṣādṛṣirnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1 ||
oṃ puruṣamedhāḥ puruṣasya nārāyaṇasyārṣam | oṃ sahasraśīrṣāḥ puruṣa sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvā'tya'tiṣṭhaddaśāṃgulam || 1 ||
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhavyam | utā'mṛtatvasyeśāno yada'nnenā'tirohati || 2 ||
etāvāna'sya mahimā'to jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ | pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripāda'syā'mṛtaṃ divi || 3 ||
tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pādo'syehā'bhavatpunaḥ | tato viśvaṃ vyakrāmatsāśanā'naśane abhi || 4 ||
tasmādvirāḍa'jāyata virājo adhipūruṣaḥ | sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmima'tho puraḥ || 5 ||
yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñama'tanvata | vasanto asyā'sīdā'jyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ || 6 ||
taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣanpuruṣaṃ jātama'grataḥ | tena devā ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye || 8 ||
tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ pṛṣadā'jyam | paśūṃstāṃścake vāyavyānā'raṇyāngrāmyāṃśca ye || 7 ||
tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire | chandāṃsi jajñire tasmādyajustasmāda'jāyata || 9 ||
tasmāda'śvā ajāyanta ye ke cobhayādataḥ | gāvo ha jajñire tasmāttasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ || 10 ||
yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayan | mukhaṃ kima'sya kau bāhū kā ūrū pādā ucyete || 11 ||
brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamā'sīdbāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ | ūrū tada'sya yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata || 12 ||
candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata | mukhādindraścāgniśca prāṇādvāyura'jāyata || 13 ||
nābhyā āsīda'ntarikṣaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata | padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāttathā lokā'kalpayan || 14 ||

gāyatryā cā'bhimaṃtrya || 6 || tato jalenā'bhyukṣya | oṃ ucchiṣṭocchiṣṭopahataṃ yacca pāpena hataṃ mṛtasūtakādvā | vasoḥ pavitrama'gniḥ savituśca raśmayaḥ punantva'nnaṃ mama duṣkṛtaṃ yaccā'nyat || 7 || oṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ(0) || 8 || iti ca | tato dakṣiṇabhāge bhūmau | oṃ bhūpatayenamaḥ oṃ bhuvanapataye namaḥ oṃ bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ | iti balitrayaṃ nivedya | ye kecidyatra tatrasthāḥ pretabhāgavaśā'nugāḥ | ihaiva bhūmau te sarve maddattalepama'dyatām || 9 || iti lepaṃ bhūmau prakṣālya antaścarasi bhūteṣu iti brahmārpaṇaṃ brahmahavirbrahmā'gnau brahmaṇā hutam | brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhinā || 11 || oṃ amṛtopastaraṇama'sisvāhā ityā'camya | prāṇāyasvāhā iti tarjanīmadhyamābhyāṃ | apānāya svāhā iti madhyamā'nāmikāṅguṣṭhaiḥ | samānāya svāhā iti kaniṣṭhā'nāmikā'ṅguṣṭhaiḥ udānāya svāhā iti tarjanīṃvinā'ṅgulibhiḥ || vyānāya svāhā iti savāṅglibhirdattāmā'hutiṃ jihvayaivā'tvā | śeṣamiṣṭadevatāmaṃtramaṃtritaṃ pratyekaṃ grāsaṃ grasitvā | gaṇḍūṣairmukhaṃ viśodhya | oṃ amṛtāpidhānamasi svāhā ityā'camya ||
ye kāṃkṣaṇamānā jīvā vai ye ca karmavaśā'nugāḥ | bhuñjatāṃ te mamocchiṣṭaṃ pātraśeṣaṃ samarpitaṃ || 12 || ityabhimaṃtrya śeṣānnaṃ bhūmau nirvapet ||
dakṣiṇakarāṅguṣṭhena dakṣiṇapādāṅguṣṭhaṃ |
aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣaḥ so'ṅguṣṭhāgramupāśritaḥ | īśaḥ sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ prīṇātu viśvabhuk || 13 || iti niplāvayitvā |
śaryātiśca sukanyā ca śakraśca cyavano'śvinau | ṣaḍete gāruḍīṃ dṛṣṭiṃ mahyaṃ dadatu sarvadā || 14 || iti netrayora'ṅguṣṭhenodakaṃ saṃspṛśya | iṣṭadevatāṃ smaran | prāno'gniḥ paramātmā vai pañcavāyusamāśritaḥ |
sa prītaḥ prīṇātu viśvaṃ viśvabhuk || 15 ||
viśvo'si vaiśvānaro'si viśvamā'bhāsase jāyamānaḥ | viśanti tvāmā'hutayaśca sarvāḥ prajāstatra yatra viśvā'mṛtosi || 16 ||
ahaṃ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṃ dehamā'śritaḥ | prāṇā'pānasamāyuktaḥ pacāmya'nnaṃ caturvidham || 17 ||
ahama'nnamahamannadaḥ ahamannādaḥ ||
agastyaḥ kumbhakarṇaśca bhīmaśca vaḍavānalaḥ | bhojanānte smarennityaṃ kukṣau rogo na jāyate || 19 ||
rājñāṃ śivaṃ cā'stu tathā dvijānāṃ gavāṃ śivaṃ cā'stu tathā prajānām | ātaṅkahīnaṃ jagada'stu sarvaṃ doṣā vināśaṃ sakalāḥ prayāntu || 20 || iti paṭhet ||
[iti bhojanavidhiḥ] ||
[atha gurustutiḥ]
oṃ brahmā'nandaṃ paramasukhadaṃ kevalaṃ jñānamūrtiṃ dvandvātītaṃ gaganasadṛśaṃ tattvama'syā'dilakṣyam | ekaṃ nityaṃ vimalama'calaṃ sarvadhīsākṣibhūtaṃ bhāvā'tītaṃ triguṇarahitaṃ sadguruṃ taṃ namāmi || 1 ||
smāraṃ smāraṃ janimṛtibhayaṃ jātanirvedavṛtti(-) rdhyāyaṃ dhyāyaṃ paśupatimumākāntama'ntarniṣaṇṇam | pāyaṃ pāyaṃ sapadi paramānandapīyūṣadhārā bhūyo bhūyo nijagurupadā'mbhojayugmaṃ namāmi || 2 ||
yasya deve parā bhaktiryathā deve tathā gurau | tasyaite kathitā hyarthāḥ prakāśyante mahātmanaḥ || 3 ||
namāmi sadguruṃ śāntaṃ pratyakṣaṃ śivarūpiṇam | śirasā yogapīṭhasthaṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhaye || 4 ||
śrīguruṃ paramānandaṃ vande ānandavigraham | yasya sānnidhyamātreṇa cidā'nandāyate param || 5 ||
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 6 ||
ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānā'ñjanaśalākayā | cakṣurunmūlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 7 ||
harau ruṣṭe gurustrātā gurau ruṣṭe na kaścana | sarvadevasvarūpāya tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 8 ||
gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurguruḥ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ | gurureva jagatsarvaṃ tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 9 ||
dhyānamūlaṃ gurormūrtiḥ pūjāmūlaṃ guroḥ padam | jñānamūlaṃ gurorvākyaṃ mokṣamūlaṃ guroḥ kṛpā || 10 ||
namaste nātha bhagavan śivāya gururūpiṇe | vidyāvatārasaṃsiddhyai svīkṛtā'nekavigraha || 11 ||
navāya navarūpāya paramārthaikarūpiṇe | sarvā'jñānatamobhedabhānave cidghanāya te || 12 ||
svatantrāya dayākḷptavigrahāya parātmane | paratantrāya bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhavyahetave || 13 ||
jñānināṃ jñānarūpāya prakāśāya prakāśinām | vivekināṃ vivekāya vimarśāya vimarśinām || 14 ||
purastātpārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe namaskuryāmuparya'dhaḥ | sadā maccittarūpeṇa vidhehi bhavadā'sanam || 15 ||
[iti śrīgurustutiḥ ]|
[atha mahāgāyatrīstutiḥ] |
sadā gaveṣayan jagattrayeṣu vedamātaraṃ cidā'tmanā kṛtasthitiṃ samatra cā'dya labdhavān | uda'sru gadgadaṃ mahodayātpraṇaumi bhaktinau(-) kayā sudustaraṃ drutaṃ titīrṣurā'pada'rṇavam || 1 ||
sudīnalokapātinī satāṃ kṛpā'tiśobhate hya'taḥ sudhāṃśucakṣuṣekṣayā'mba (!) mādṛśaṃ janam | navā'pi hīyate taveṣadīśi (!) pālanena no bhavāt yataḥ kuputratā na bhāsate prasūhṛdi || 2 ||
namāmi muktavidrumaprataptahāṭakā'sitā'(-) vadātavarṇasundaraiḥ ṣaḍa'rdhalolalocanaiḥ | sarojaṣaṇḍabāndhavaprataptahāṭakaprabhaiḥ kirīṭaratnaraṃjitaiḥ sudhāṃśukhaṇḍamaṃḍitaiḥ || 3 ||
mukhairdaśārdhasaṃmitairvirājamānavigrahāṃ sureśacāpasaprabhāṃ samastadevavanditām | varā'bhayā'ṅkuśā'nvitaiḥ kapālaśūlaśaṅkhaca(-) krasārasadvayīguṇā'ṅkitaiḥ karairvirājitām || 4 ||
bhavadrumasya mūlatāṃ gatāṃ munīndravanditā(-) ma'khaṇḍabhāvamaṇḍalaprakāśakāriṇīṃ śivām | samastadevatāmayīṃ samastasiddhidāyinī(-) ma'pūrvarūpavigrahāṃ sarasvatīṃ bhavārtihām || 5 ||
śucīndusūryalocanāṃ śucīndusūryavigrahāṃ śucīndusūryasaṅgamasvabhāvaśālinīṃ śubhām | padadvayā'nukampitasvaśakticakrasevitāṃ pareśaśaktimuttamāṃ bhaje trilokasundarīm || 6 ||
mahāmaheśvarījagadvisargasusthitikṣaya(-) svatantratā śarīriṇī babhūva yā maheśituḥ |
dvipatritā'dibhedato latāyamānavigrahā trayīśvarī sadā tu sā jagajjayāya jāyatām || 7 ||
namāmi tanmukhā'ravindapañcakaṃ malā'pahaṃ galaikanālakaṃ sadāvikāsi bhaktisambhavam | svabhaktahaṃsasevitaṃ śucīndupadmabandhavaḥ pratīkabhūtavigrahā gatā hi yatra pañcatām || 8 ||
bhavā'rṇave'tiduḥsahasmarā'dhidigdhamānasaṃ ṣaḍ(-)ūrminityapīḍitaṃ janaṃ didhīrṣumānasā | śrutidhvanisphuranmukhā'ravindabhūsuraiḥ sadā trisandhyamīśvarī nutā'stu sā sukhapradā hi naḥ || 9 ||
trayiprasūḥ svadṛṣṭipātadhūtabhaktikalmaṣā samairjanairnutā mudā svavarṇadharmabhedataḥ | nilimpanimnagāmiṣeṇa pādadhautajaṃ jalaṃ yadīyamā'gataṃ kṣitiṃ tanonu naḥ śivaṃ tu sā || 10 ||
svadambhavañcitā'khilaṃ kubhogasaktamānasaṃ sadāśuciṃ kumārgagaṃ śaṭhaṃ ca śaṃkase yadi | kathaṃ svapādacintanotthavaibhavaṃ nahīśvari (!) yato'ṅghricintakaṃ dayādṛśekṣase na mādṛśam || 11 ||
anekadoṣadūṣiteṣva'nirvivecanā satī svatantraśaktirīśvarī bhavāghanāśakāriṇī | kṛpāmayīṃ dṛśaṃ vidhāya sā svabhaktipātritaṃ svapatkaje madhuvrataṃ karotu māma'harniśam || 12 ||
trisandhyamiṣṭadaivataṃ sukeśavāsyajaṃ stavaṃ smaran hṛdīddhabhāvano vidhāya vedamātaram | vidhūya pāpasañcayaṃ vitīrya kīrtimuttamā(-) mihatva'mutra kaivalaṃ padaṃ sa yāti nirbhayam || 13 ||
[iti śrīmahāgāyatrīlīlāstutiḥ] |
[prārthanāstutiḥ] ||
oṃ durnivārabhavadhvānta dhvaṃsanaikakṛtekṣaṇām naumi mohavināśāya bhīto brahmādidaivatām || 1 ||
durgatiṃ hara me devi bahujanmaśatārjitām | prāpya kalpatarucchāyāṃ kathaṃ santapyate janaiḥ || 2 ||
paśya māmā'śu gāyatri bibhyataṃ snigdhacakṣuṣā | na bālama'balaṃ putraṃ muñcatya'gragamambikā || 3 ||
ehi māṃ pāṇipadmena dehi tūrṇaṃ varaṃ śubham | mahāmohā'kulaṃ dīnamehi māṃ spṛśa nityaśaḥ || 4 ||
mātaḥ pratīkṣate nā'rto yattadā'śu prasīda me | hitvā'kṣasūttraṃ sāvitri nirvighnaṃ paśya māmiha || 5 ||
śṛṇvato nā'nyakṛtyaṃ syāttattvaṃ parahitaṃ kuru | brahmaviṣṇuharādyāstvāmā'śrayanti sureśvari || 6 || iti prārthanāstutiḥ
[atha sarasvatīstutiḥ] ||
oṃ sitavarṇā'laṅkāre (!) sarasvati (!) samastavāṅmayā'dhāre (!) kamalajamānasavarale (!) mṛgāṅkadhavale (!) namastubhyam || 1 ||
dhanyaḥ sa eva loke sa eva pūjyaḥ sa eva sarvaguruḥ | yasya mukhakamalakośe vāṅmayi kuladevate (!) vasasi || 2 ||
kastvāṃ vinā vivekī vivekavikalasya niṣphalaṃ janma | tasmādbhārati bhavināṃ tvameva heturviveke'pi || 3 ||
lakṣmīvāna'pi puruṣaḥ śūraḥ subhago'pi kāmasamarūpaḥ | vṛṣa iva vibudhasabhāyāṃ pratibhātya'male (!) tvayā rahitaḥ || 4 ||
munimanujamānanīyo māta (!) rmūrkho'pi mānavo dakṣaḥ | niśśeṣaśāstravaktā tvanmaṃtradhyānato bhavati || 5 ||
kuvalayadṛśaḥ kva tāvadveśmani vilasanti kucabharā'namrāḥ | yāvada'sitā'bjanayane (!) na tvaṃ tuṣṭāsi devi bhuvi bhavinām || 6 ||
jitvā naro'rirājakama'gagurugajavājipuruṣabalasahitaḥ | yadupaiti tatsamagraṃ tvaccaraṇanuteḥ phalaṃ tasya || 7 ||
āvarjitā'pi kaṣṭairiha janmani muñcati naraṃ śrīḥ | na tvaṃ satprabhaveṣviti matvā ko nauti no bhavatīm || 8 ||
kavivaravadanasaroruha viharaṇavisrambhavibhramadbhramari (!) bhagavati (!) pañcamukhīśvari (!) vāgīśvari (!) namaste'stu || 9 ||
śambhupraṇatāṃ vāṇīṃ bhaktyā yaḥstauti so'cireṇaiva | avahitabuddhiprasaro kavirājo jāyate manujaḥ || 10 ||
[iti kālidāsakṛtā sarasvatīstutiḥ] |
[atha gaurīstutiḥ] ||
oṃ līlā'rabdhasthāpitaluptā'khilalokāṃ lokā'tītairyogibhirantarhṛdimṛgyām | bālā'dityaśreṇisamānadyutipuṃjāṃ gaurīma'mbāma'mburuhākṣīma'hamīḍe || 1 ||
āśāpāśakleśavināśaṃ vidadhānāṃ pādā'mbhojadhyānaparāṇāṃ puruṣāṇām | īśīmīśāṅgā'rdhaharāṃ tāṃ tanumadhyāṃ gaurīma'mbāma'mburuhākṣī(0) || 2 ||
pratyāhāradhyānasamādhisthitibhājāṃ nityaṃ citte nirvṛtikāṣṭhāṃ kalayantīm | satyajñānā'nandamayīṃ tāṃ taḍidā'bhāṃ gaurīma'mbāma'mburuhākṣī(0) || 3 ||
candrā'pīḍā'nanditamandasmitavaktrāṃ candrā'pīḍā'laṅkṛtalolā'lakabhārām | indropendrādya'rcitapādā'mbujayugmāṃ gaurīma'mbāma'mburuhākṣī(0) || 4 ||
nānākāraiḥ śaktikadambairbhuvanāni vyāpya svairaṃ krīḍati yā'sau svayamekā | kalyāṇīṃ tāṃ kalpalatāmā'natibhājāṃ gaurīma'mbāma'mburuhākṣī(0) || 5 ||
mūlādhārādutthitavantīṃ vidhirandhraṃ sauraṃ cāndraṃ dhāma vihāya jvalitāṅgīm | sthūlāṃ sūkṣmāṃ sūkṣmatarāṃ tāma'bhivandyāṃ gaurīma'mbāmamburuhākṣī(0) || 6 ||
ādikṣāntāma'kṣaramūrtyā vilasantīṃ bhūte bhūte bhūtakadambaṃ prasavitrīm | śabdabrahmā'nandamayīṃ tāma'bhirāmāṃ gaurīma'mbāmamburuhākṣī(0) || 7 ||
yasyāḥ kakṣau līnama'khaṇḍaṃ jagada'ṇḍaṃ bhūyo bhūyaḥ prādurabhūda'kṣatameva | bhartrā sārdhaṃ tāṃ sphaṭikādrau viharantīṃ gaurima'mbāmamburuhākṣī(0) || 8 ||
yasyāmetatprotama'śeṣaṃ maṇimālā sūtre yadvatkvā'pi caraṃ cā'pya'caraṃ ca | tāma'dhyātmajñānapadavyā gamanīyāṃ gaurīma'mbāma'mburuhākṣī(0) || 9 ||
nityaḥ satyo niṣkala eko jagadīśaḥ sākṣī yasyāḥ sargavidhau saṃharaṇe ca | viśvatrāṇakrīḍanaśīlāṃ śivapatnīṃ gaurīma'mbāma'mburuhākṣī(0) || 10 ||
prātaḥkāle bhāvaviśuddhiṃ vidadhāno bhaktyā nityaṃ jalpati gaurīdaśakaṃ yaḥ | vācāṃ siddhiṃ sampadamuccaiḥ śivabhaktiṃ tasyā'vaśyaṃ parvataputrī vidadhāti || 11 ||
[iti śrīgaurīstutiḥ sampūrṇā] ||
[atha mukundamālāstutiḥ] ||
oṃ vande mukundama'ravindadalā'yatā'kṣaṃ kundenduśaṅkhadaśanaṃ śiśugopaveśam | indrādidevagaṇavanditapādapīṭhaṃ vṛndāvanā'layama'haṃ vasudevasūnum || 1 ||
śrīvallabheti varadeti dayāpareti bhaktapriyeti bhavaluṇṭhanakovideti | nātheti nāgaśayaneti jagannivāse tyā'lāpinaṃ pratidinaṃ kuru māṃ mukunda || 2 ||
jayatu jayatu devo devakīnandano'yaṃ jayatu jayatu kṛṣṇo vṛṣṇivaṃ'sapradīpaḥ | jayatu jayatu meghaśyāmalaḥ komalāṅgo jayatu jayatu pṛthvībhāranāśo mukundaḥ || 3 ||
mukunda mūrdhnā praṇipatya yāce bhavantamekāntamiyantama'rtham | avismṛtistvaccaraṇā'ravinde bhave bhave me'stu bhavatprasādāt || 4 ||
śrīmukundapadāmbhojamadhunaḥ paramā'dbhutam | yatpāyino na muhyanti muhyanti yada'pāyinaḥ || 5 ||
nā'haṃ vande tava caraṇayordvandvama'dvandvahetoḥ kumbhīpākaṃ guruma'pi hare (!) nārakaṃ nā'panetum | ramyārāmāmṛdutanulatā naṃdane nā'pi rantuṃ bhāve bhāve hṛdayabhavane bhāvayeyaṃ bhavantam || 6 ||
nā'sthā dharme na vasunicaye naiva kāmopabhoge yadyadbhavyaṃ bhavatu bhagavan (!) pūrvakarmā'nurūpam | etatprārthyaṃ mama bahumataṃ janmajanmāntare'pi tvatpādā'mbhoruhayugagatā niścalā bhaktira'stu || 7 ||
divi vā bhuvi vā mamā'stu vāso narake vā narakāntaka prakāmam | ādhīritaśāradā'ravindau caraṇau te maraṇe'pi cintayāmi || 8 ||
sarasijanayane saśaṅkhacakre murabhidi mā virameha citta rantum | sukhatarama'paraṃ na jātu jāne haricaraṇasmaraṇā'mṛtena tulyam || 9 ||
mā bhairmandamano (!) vicintya bahudhā yāmīściraṃ yātanā nā'mī naḥ prabhavanti pāparipavaḥ svāmī nanu śrīdharaḥ | ālasyaṃ vyapanīya bhaktisulabhaṃ dhyāyasva nārāyaṇaṃ lokasya vyasanā'panodanakaro dāsasya kiṃ na kṣamaḥ || 10 ||
bhavajaladhima'gādhaṃ dustaraṃ nistareyaṃ kathama'hamiti ceto mā sma gāḥ kātaratvam | sarasijadṛśi deve tāvakī bhaktirekā narakabhidi niṣaṇṇā tārayiṣyatya'vaśyam || 11 ||
tṛṣṇātoye madanapavanoddhūtamohormimāle dārā'varte tanayasahajagrāhasaṅghā'kule ca | saṃsārā'khye mahati jaladhau majjatāṃ nastridhāman (!) pādā'mbhoje varada (!) bhavato bhaktināve prasīda || 12 ||
pṛthvī reṇura'ṇuḥ payāṃsi kaṇikā phalguḥ sphuliṅgo laghu(-) stejo niḥśvasanaṃ maruttanutaraṃ randhraṃ susūkṣmaṃ nabhaḥ | kṣudrā rudrapitāmahaprabhṛtayaḥ kīṭāḥ samastāḥ surā dṛṣṭe yatra sa tāvako vijayate bhūmā'vadhūtā'vadhi || 13 ||
āmnāyā'bhyasitānya'raṇyaruditaṃ kṛcchravratānya'nvahaṃ bhedacchedaphalāni pūrtavidhayaḥ sarvaṃ hutaṃ bhasmani | tīrthānāma'vagāhanāni ca gajasnānaṃ vinā yatpada(-) dvandvā'mbhoruhasaṃstutiṃ vijayate devaḥ sa nārāyaṇaḥ || 14 ||
bhavajaladhigatānāṃ dvandvavātāhatānāṃ sutaduhitṛkalatratrāṇabhārāvṛtānām | viṣamaviṣayatoye majjatāma'plavānāṃ bhavati śaraṇameko viṣṇupoto narāṇām || 15 ||
rajasi nipatitānāṃ mohajālāvṛtānāṃ jananamaraṇadhūlidurgatiṃ saṃgatānām | śaraṇama'śaraṇānāmeka evā'turāṇāṃ kuśalapathi niyoktā cakrapāṇirnarāṇām || 16 ||
aparādhasahasrasaṃkulaṃ patitaṃ bhīmabhavārṇavodare | agatiṃ śaraṇāgataṃ hare (!) kṛpayā kevalamā'tmasātkuru || 17 ||
yaccintitaṃ ca manasā vacasā yaduktaṃ cakṣuḥkaraśravaṇapādaviceṣṭitaṃ ca | yadyanniśāsu divaseṣu kṛtaṃ mayaiva tattajjanārdana (!) tavā'rcanameva bhūyāt || 18 ||
mā me strītvaṃ mā ca me dāsabhāvo mā mūrkhatvaṃ mā kudeśeṣu janma | mithyā dṛṣṭirmā ca me syātkadācijjātau jātau viṣṇubhakto bhavāmi || 19 ||
ānanda (!) govinda (!) mukunda (!) rāma (!) nārāyaṇā'nanta (!) nirāmayeti | vaktuṃ samartho'pi na vakti kaścida'ho janānāṃ vayasanāni mokṣe || 20 ||
kṣīrasāgarataraṅgaśīkarā'sāratārakitacārumūrtaye | bhogibhogaśayanīyaśāyine mādhavāya madhuvidviṣe namaḥ || 21 ||
kṣīrasārama'panīyaśaṅkayā svīkṛtaṃ yadi palāyanaṃ tvayā | mānase mama nitāntatāmase nandanandana kuto na līyase || 22 ||
vātsalyāda'bhayapradānasamayādā'rtārtinirvāpaṇāt audāryāda'ghaśoṣaṇāda'gaṇitaśreyaḥpadaprāpaṇāt | sevyaḥ śrīpatireva sarvajagatāmekāntataḥ sākṣiṇaḥ prahlādaśca vibhīṣaṇaśca karirāṭ pāñcālya'halyā dhruvaḥ || 23 ||
nāthe śrīpuruṣottame trijagatāmekādhipe cetasā sevye svasya padasya dātari pare nārāyaṇe tiṣṭhati | yaṃ kaṃcitpuruṣādhamaṃ katipayagrāmeśamalpā'rthadaṃ sevāyai mṛgayāmahe narama'ho mūḍhā varākā vayam || 24 ||
he lokāḥ (!) śṛṇuta prasūtimaraṇavyādheścikitsāmimāṃ yogajñāḥ samudāharanti munayo yāṃ yājñavalkyādayaḥ | antarjyotira'meyamekama'mṛtaṃ kṛṣṇākhyamā'pīyatāṃ tatpītaṃ paramauṣadhaṃ vitanute nirvāṇamā'tyantikam || 25 ||
baddhenā'ñjalinā natena śirasā gātraiḥ saromodgamaiḥ kaṇṭhena svaragadgadena nayanodgīrṇena bāṣpā'mbunā | nityaṃ tvaccaraṇā'ravindayugaladhyānāmṛtā'svādinā(-) ma'smākaṃ sarasīruhākṣa (!) satataṃ sampadyatāṃ jīvitam || 26 ||
tatvaṃ bruvāṇāni paraṃ parasmāda'ho kṣarantīva sudhāṃ padāni | āvartaya prāñjalira'smi jihve nāmāni nārāyaṇagocarāṇi || 27 ||
idaṃ śarīraṃ pariṇāmapeśalaṃ patatya'vaśyaṃ ślarthasandhijarjaram | kimauṣadhaiḥ kliśyasi mūḍha durmate (!) nirāmayaṃ kṛṣṇarasayanaṃ piba || 28 ||
śrīmannāma procya nārāyaṇā'khyaṃ ke na prāptā vāñchitaṃ pāpino'pi | hā naḥ pūrvaṃ vākpravṛttā na tasmiṃstena prāptaṃ garbhavāsādiduḥkham || 29 ||
mādrākṣaṃ kṣīṇapuṇyān kṣaṇama'pi bhavato bhaktihīnān padābje māśrauṣaṃ śrāvyabaddhaṃ tava caritama'pāsyā'nyadā'khyānajātam | māsprākṣaṃ mādhava (!) tvāmapi bhuvanapatiṃ cetasā'pahnavānaṃ mābhūvaṃ tvatsaparyā vyatikararahito janmajanmāntare'pi || 30 ||
madana (!) parihara sthitiṃ madīye manasi mukundapadāravindadhāmni | haranayanakṛśānunā kṛśo'si smarasi na cakraparākramaṃ murāreḥ || 31 ||
dārā vārākaravarasutā te'ṅgajoyaṃ viriñciḥ stotā vedāstava suragaṇo bhṛtyavargaḥ prasādaḥ | muktirmadhye jagada'vikalaṃ tāvakī devakīyaṃ mātā mitraṃ balaripusutastatvato'nyanna jāne || 32 ||
jihve (!) kīrtaya keśavaṃ muraripuṃ ceto (!) bhaja śrīdharaṃ pāṇidvaṃdva (!) samarcayā'cyutakathāḥ śrotradvaya (!) tvaṃ śṛṇu | kṛṣṇaṃ lokaya locanadvaya (!) harergacchāṅghriyugmā'layaṃ jighra ghrāṇa (!) mukundapādatulasīṃ mūrdhan (!) namā'dhokṣajam || 33 ||
yatkrṣṇapraṇipātadhūlidhavalaṃ tadvai śiraḥ syācchubhaṃ te netre tamasojjhite surucire yābhyāṃ harirdṛśyate | sā buddhirniyamairyamaiśca vimalā yā mādhavadhyāyinī sā jihvā'mṛtavarṣiṇī pratipadaṃ yā stauti nārāyaṇam || 34 ||
bhaktadveṣabhujaṅgagāruḍamaṇistrailokyarakṣāmaṇi(-) rgopīlocanacātakā'mbudamaṇiḥ saundaryamudrāmaṇiḥ | śrīkāntāmaṇirukmiṇīghanakuca dvandvaikabhūṣāmaṇiḥ śreyo dhyeyaśikhāmaṇirdiśatu no gopālacūḍāmaṇiḥ || 35 ||
śatrucchedaikamantraṃ sakalamupaniṣadvākyasaṃpūjyamantraṃ saṃsārottāramaṃtraṃ samuditatamasāṃ saṃganiryāṇamaṃtram
sarvaiśvaryaikamaṃtraṃ vyasanabhujagasandaṣṭasantrāṇamantraṃ jihve(!) śrīkṛṣṇamantraṃ japa japa satataṃ janmasāphalyamantram || 36 ||
vyāmohoddalanauṣadhaṃ munimano vṛttipravṛtyauṣadhaḥ daityā'narthakarauṣadhaṃ tribhuvane saṃjīvanaikauṣadham | bhaktā'rtipraśamauṣadhaṃ bhavabhayapradhvaṃsi divyauṣadhaṃ śreyaḥprāptikarauṣadhaṃ piba manaḥ (!) śrīkṛṣṇanāmauṣadham || 37 ||
āścaryametaddhi manuṣyaloke sudhāṃ parityajya viṣaṃ pibanti | nāmāni nārāyaṇagocarāṇi tyaktvā'nyavācaḥ kuhakāḥ paṭhanti || 38 ||
lāṭī netrapuṭī payodharaghaṭī krīḍākuṭī dostaṭī pāṭīradrumavarṇanena kavibhirmūḍhairdinaṃ nīyate | govindeti janārdaneti jagatāṃ nātheti kṛṣṇeti ca vyāhāraiḥ samayastadekamanasāṃ puṃsāṃ parikrāmati || 39 ||
ayācyama'kreyama'yātayāmama'pācyama'kṣayyama'durbharaṃ me | astyeva pātheyama'tiprayāṇe śrīkṛṣṇanāmā'mṛtabhāgadheyam || 40 ||
yasya priyau śrutidharau ravilokagītau mitre dvijanmaparivāraśivāvabhūtām | tenā'mbujākṣacaraṇāmbujaṣaṭpadena rājñāṃ kṛtā stutiriyaṃ kulaśekhareṇa || 41 ||
[śrīkulaśekhararājñākṛtā mukundamālāstutiḥ ]
[atha śrīkṛṣṇalīlā] ||
oṃ nigamataroḥ pratiśākhaṃ mṛgitaṃ ca mayā parabrahma | militamidānīma'ṅke gokulapaṅkeruhākṣīṇām || 1 ||
taptaṃ tapobhira'nyaiḥ phalitaṃ ca tadgopabālānām | āsāṃ yatkucakumbhe nīlanicolāyate paraṃ brahma || 2 ||
śrutima'pare smṛtima'pare bhāratama'nye bhajantu bhavabhītāḥ | ahama'pi nandaṃ vande yasyā'linde paraṃ brahma || 3 ||
kiṃ kathayāmaḥ kasmai kasya manaḥ pratyayamā'datte | ramayati gopavadhūṭīkuñjakuṭīre paraṃ brahma || 4 ||
nītaṃ navanavanītaṃ kena ca pītaṃ payaḥ kva me muralī | iti samudīrya luṭhantaṃ bhumau bālaṃ namāmi gopālam || 5 ||
paśyata balama'balānāma'nāvile hṛdbile babandhuryāḥ | tanu dṛṣṭipātaraśmyā'kṛṣṭama'mūrtaṃ paraṃ brahma || 6 ||
etattvāma'hama'rthayāmi satataṃ re citta (!) cintātura (!) mā cintāṃ kuru cañcaleṣu viṣayeṣvā'gāradārā'diṣu | gāyantaṃ yamunātaṭadrumatale nīlāmbudaśyāmalaṃ gopālaṃ vanamālinaṃ kamalinaṃ nandātmajaṃ cintaya || 7 ||
dhyānā'bhyāsavaśīkṛtena manasā tannirguṇaṃ niṣkriyaṃ jyotiḥ kiṃcana yogino yadi paraṃ paśyanti paśyantu te | asmākaṃ tu tadeva locanacamatkārāya bhūyācciraṃ kālindīpulineṣu tatkimapi yannīlaṃ tamo dhāvati || 8 || [iti kṛṣṇalīlā] (0)
[atha jayastutirviṣṇoḥ] ||
oṃ jaya nārāyaṇa (!) jaya puruṣottama (!) jaya vāmana (!) kaṃsāre (!) uddhara māma'sureśavināśin (!) patito'haṃ saṃsāre | ghoraṃ hara mama narakaripo (!) keśava (!) kalmaṣabhāraṃ māma'nukampaya dīnama'nāthaṃ kuru bhavasāgarapāram || 1 ||
jaya jaya deva (!) jayā'surasūdana (!) jaya keśava (!) jaya viṣṇo (!) jaya lakṣmīmukhakamalamadhuvrata (!) jaya daśakandarajiṣṇo (!) || ghoraṃ(0) || 2 ||
tvaṃ jananī janakaḥ prabhura'cyuta (!) tvaṃ putrasuhṛddhanamitram | tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ śaraṇā'gatavatsala (!) tvaṃ bhavajaladhivahitram || ghoraṃ || 3 ||
punara'pi jananaṃ punarapi maraṇaṃ punara'pi garbhanivāsaṃ | soḍhuma'laṃ punara'sminmādhava (!) māmuddhara nijadāsam || ghoraṃ(0) || 4 ||
janakasutāpaticaraṇaparāyaṇaśaṃkaramunivaragītaṃ dhāraya manasi kṛṣṇa (!) puruṣottama (!) vāraya saṃsṛtibhītim || ghoraṃ(0) || 5 ||
yadyapi sakalama'haṃ kalayāmi hare (!) nahi kima'pi sasatvaṃ | tada'pi na muñcati māmidama'cyuta (!) putrakalatramamattvam || 6 || [iti viṣṇustutiḥ ]
[govindāṣṭakaṃ] ||
oṃ satyaṃjñānama'nantaṃ nityama'nākāśaṃ paramā'kāśaṃ goṣṭhaprāṅgaṇariṅkhaṇalolaḥma'nāyāsaṃ paramāyāsam | māyākalpitanānākārama'nākāraṃ bhuvanākāraṃ kṣmāmānāthama'nāthaṃ praṇamata govindaṃ paramānandam || 1 ||
mṛtsnāma'tsīheti yaśodā tāḍanaśaiśavasantrāsaṃ vyāditavaktrā'lokita lokā'lokacaturdaśalokā'lim | lokatrayapuramūlastaṃbhaṃ lokālokama'nālokaṃ lokeśaṃ parameśaṃ pra(0) || 2 ||
traiviṣṭaparipuvīraghnaṃ kṣitibhāraghnaṃ bhavarogaghnaṃ kaivalyaṃ navanītā'hārama'nāhāraṃ bhuvanāhāram | vaimalyasphuṭacetovṛttiviśeṣā'bhāsama'nābhāsaṃ śaivaṃ kevalaśāntaṃ pra(0) || 3 ||
gopālaṃ prabhulīlāvigraha gopālaṃ kulagopālaṃ gopīkhelanagovardhanadhṛtilīlālālitagopālam | gobhirnigaditagovinda sphuṭanāmānaṃ bahunāmānaṃ godhīgocaradūraṃ pra(0) || 4 ||
gopīmaṇḍalagoṣṭhībhedaṃ bhedā'vasthamabhedā'bhaṃ śaśadgokhuranirdhūtoddhata dhūlidhūsarasaubhāgyam | śraddhābhaktigṛhītā'nandama'cintyaṃ cintitasadbhāvaṃ cintāmaṇima'nimānaṃ || 5 ||
snānavyākulayoṣidvastrāṇyā'dāyā'gamupārūḍhaṃ vyāditsantīra'tha digvastrā vastraṃ dātumupākarṣataṃ tāḥ | nirdhūtadvayaśokavimohaṃ buddhaṃ buddherantaḥsthaṃ sattāmātraśarīraṃ pra(0) || 6 ||
kāntaṃ kāraṇakāraṇamā'dima'nādiṃ kālaghanā'bhāsaṃ kālindīgatakāliya śirasi nṛtyantaṃ muhurnṛtyantam | kālaṃ kālakalā'tītaṃ kalitā'śeṣaṃ kalidoṣajñaṃ kālatrayagatihetuṃ pra(0) || 7 ||
vṛndāvanabhuvi vṛndārakagaṇaḥ vṛndā'rādhitavandyehaṃ kundā'bhā'malamandasmera svadhānandaṃ suhṛdā'nandam | vandyā'śeṣamahāmuni mānasavandyā'nandapadadvandvaṃ vandyā'śeṣaguṇābdhiṃ pra(0) || 8 ||
govindā'ṣṭakametada'dhīte govindārpitacetā yo govindā'cyuta (!) mādhava (!) viṣṇo (!) gokulanāyaka (!) kṛṣṇeti |
govindāṃghrisarojadhyānajaladhautasamastā'gho govindaṃ paramānandā'mṛtama'ntasthaṃ samabhyeti || 9 ||
[iti śrīśaṃkarācāryakṛtaṃ govindāṣṭakaṃ sampūrṇam ]
[atha śivastutiḥ] ||
oṃ vyāptacarā'carabhāvaviśeṣaṃ cinmayamekama'nantamanādim | bhairavanāthama'nāthaśaraṇyaṃ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi vande || 1 ||
tvanmayametada'śes'midānīṃ bhāti mama tvada'nugrahaśaktyā | tvaṃ ca maheśa (!) sadaiva mamā'tmā svā'tmamayaṃ mama tena samastam || 2 ||
svātma'ni viśvagate tvayi nāthe tena na saṃsṛtibhīteḥ kathā'sti | satsvapi durdharaduḥkhavimoha trāsavidhāyiṣu karmagaṇeṣu || 3 ||
antaka (!) māṃ prati mā dṛśamenāṃ krodhakarālatamāṃ vidadhīhi | śaṅkarasevanacintanadhīro bhīṣaṇabhairavaśaktimayo'smi || 4 ||
itthamupoḍhabhavanmayasaṃviddidhitidāritabhūritamisraḥ | mṛtyuyamāntakakarmapiśācairnātha (!) namo'stu na jātu bibhemi || 5 ||
proditasatyavibodhamarīci prokṣitaviśvapadārthasatattvaḥ | bhāvaparāmṛtanirbharapūrṇe tvayya'hamā'tmani nirvṛtimemi || 6 ||
mānasagocarameti yadaiva kleśadaśā'tanutāpavidhātrī | nātha (!) tadaiva mamatvada'bhedastotraparā'mṛtavṛṣṭirudeti || 7 ||
śaṃkara (!) satyamidaṃ vratadāna snānatapo bhavatāpavināśi | tāvakaśāstraparā'mṛtacintā sindhati cetasi nirvṛtidhārāḥ || 8 ||
nṛtyati gāyati hṛṣyati gāḍhaṃ saṃvidiyaṃ mama bhairavanātha | tvāṃ priyamā'pya sudarśanamekaṃ durlabhama'nyajanaiḥ samayajñam || 9 ||
vasurasapauṣe kṛṣṇadaśamyāma'bhinavaguptaḥ stavaidamakarot | yena vibhurbhavamarusantāpaṃ śamayati jhaṭiti janasya dayāluḥ || 10 ||
[iti abhinavaguptā'cāryakṛtā śivastutiḥ
samāptam] ||
